explication: Gitea is a self-hosted, all-in-one development service. The principal workflow begins with a user or Git client reaching the web server, which authenticates the request and coordinates repository, issue, review, project, package, or Actions operations. Results are persisted in the relational database and Git/object storage, then rendered or delivered through the web interface. The graph also preserves documented automation, search, collaboration, administration, migration, and diagnostics capabilities. Several application routes are represented from directory responsibilities; sampled excerpts chiefly confirm persistence, storage, queues, and operational wiring.
